layers.title: Data layer
layers.body: MTGJSON card database reassembled from 8 parts. Every card has parsed mana costs, keywords, tags, oracle text, and special mechanics (evoke, dash, escape, delve, domain). 25 Modern decklists with mainboard + sideboard in modern_meta.py. Per-deck gameplans as JSON goal sequences. Strategy profiles with archetype-specific AI weights.

files.name: ModernAtomic_part[1-8].json
files.note: Card database split into 8 parts for git — merged at runtime by merge_db.py

files.name: modern_meta.py
files.note: All 25 decklists + METAGAME_SHARES — single source of truth for decks

files.name: gameplans/*.json
files.note: Per-deck goal sequences: curve_out → push_damage → close_game with enablers/payoffs

files.name: strategy_profile.py
files.note: Archetype weights: burn_face_mult, attack_threshold, pass_threshold, holdback

files.name: card_knowledge.json
files.note: Static card annotations the oracle parser can't derive

layers.title: Engine layer
layers.body: Full MTG rules: turn structure, mana system with greedy constraint solver, spell stack with priority passing, combat resolution, continuous effects with layer ordering, state-based actions, zone management, and 115 card-specific effect handlers.

files.name: game_state.py
files.note: Core state machine: zones, turn phases, SBAs, triggers, continuous effects

files.name: game_runner.py
files.note: Runs a full game from shuffle to result — calls AI for decisions

files.name: card_effects.py
files.note: 115 card-specific handlers: ETB, cast triggers, activated abilities, replacement effects

files.name: card_database.py
files.note: Loads ModernAtomic.json — 22,506 cards with parsed oracle text

files.name: combat_manager.py
files.note: Declare attackers/blockers, first strike, trample, damage assignment

files.name: sideboard_manager.py
files.note: Bool-flag based SB: opp_is_aggro, opp_is_combo, opp_is_gy → swap cards

files.name: oracle_parser.py
files.note: Extracts keywords, mana costs, P/T, abilities from raw oracle text

files.name: stack.py
files.note: Spell stack with priority passing — handles counters, responses, split second

layers.title: AI layer
layers.body: EV-based decision engine. Clock evaluation (turns to kill). Bayesian hand inference tracks P(counter), P(removal). Full combat sim with blocker prediction and 5 turn orderings. Goal engine with JSON game phases. Combo assessment. Strategic logger produces reasoning traces.

files.name: ev_player.py (4163 ln)
files.note: Main AI brain: enumerate plays → score by EV + clock Δ + combo mod → pick best

files.name: gameplan.py (1120 ln)
files.note: GoalEngine: reads gameplans/*.json, tracks current goal, transitions on board state

files.name: turn_planner.py (1258 ln)
files.note: Tries 5 orderings of the same plays, picks highest total EV sequence

files.name: ev_evaluator.py (3587 ln)
files.note: EVSnapshot: board eval, life totals, hand quality, threat assessment

files.name: combo_calc.py (1368 ln)
files.note: Storm count, graveyard state for escape/delve, mana zone for combo turns

files.name: clock.py (898 ln)
files.note: Turns-to-kill calculator — the fundamental unit of MTG tempo evaluation

files.name: bhi.py (828 ln)
files.note: Bayesian Hand Inference: tracks P(Force), P(Push) from opponent's visible actions

files.name: strategic_logger.py
files.note: Logs AI reasoning: "Cast Phlage (+8.2 EV, clock 5→3)" for replay viewer

layers.title: Simulation runner

pipeline.title: Board snapshot
pipeline.body: Capture the full board state into a lightweight EVSnapshot: life totals, creature power, mana available, storm count, energy, evasion/lifelink power. Fast to create, cheap to project.
pipeline.formula: EVSnapshot { my_life: 17, opp_life: 14, my_power: 6, my_clock: 3, opp_clock: 5 }

pipeline.title: Game plan phase
pipeline.body: GoalEngine reads JSON goal sequences for each deck. Tracks whether the AI is in setup, develop, execute, or closing phase. Cards are scored by relevance to the current goal.

pipeline.title: Score all legal plays
pipeline.body: Enumerate every legal action (cast, land, cycle, equip). Score each with heuristic EV + clock delta. Clock = ceil(opp_life / effective_power). All values in life-point equivalents — one unit for everything.

pipeline.title: Bayesian hand inference
pipeline.body: BHI tracks P(counter), P(removal), P(burn) for the opponent's hand. Updates on priority passes ("they didn't counter → lower P(counter)"), spells cast, and mana availability. All from tags — no card names.

pipeline.title: Combat simulation
pipeline.body: VirtualBoard with VirtualCreatures. Enumerates attack configurations. Predicts opponent blocks using a greedy algorithm. Evaluates 5 turn orderings: deploy→attack, remove→attack, attack→deploy, hold mana, lethal push. Two-phase first strike.
pipeline.formula: best_ordering = max(deploy_attack, remove_attack, attack_deploy, hold_mana, lethal_push)

pipeline.title: Execute and log
pipeline.body: Pick the highest-EV play. Execute it through the game engine. Log full reasoning (candidate plays, EV scores, chosen action, why) via strategic_logger.py for replay viewer and LLM judge audit.
pipeline.formula: PLAY: Cast Ragavan (EV: +8.2) — threat deployment, clock improves 5→3 turns
